Occurrences.Kwic: 作業不忘，因緣會遇時，果報還自受。謝秉拂，上堂：雨注河傾，共談無義。陳蒲鞋倒退三千，睡虎子讓一頭地。有問如何若何，不能以手夾鼻。何故？切忌錯恠老僧。上堂：涅槃心，差別智，明之既難，會之不易。如千手異執，千目異顧，元同一身；似萬派爭流，百川競注，皆歸一水。雖然如是，差之毫釐，謬以千里。上堂，舉：永嘉大師道：直截根源佛所印，摘葉尋枝我不能。與麼已帶枝葉了，作麼生得直截根源去？良久，云：時暑，不宜久立。城歸，上堂：昨日動未常動，今日靜未常靜。所以道：靜謂之性，心在其中矣；動謂之心，性在其中矣。只如心性俱泯、動靜兩忘時如何？一片白雲橫谷口，數聲幽鳥語林阿。解制，上堂。昨朝結制，鎖夢關空；今朝解制，眼開天曉。且道結底是？

Senses.Explanation: The direct cut to the root of the Chan records: the one road past leaf and branch, promised more often than shown. Muzhou Daoming answers the direct-cut ask with the day's own round — off to the dawn meal, back from digging ponds in the rain — and tells the next asker pierced-ear travelers are rare, boat-carvers common, Huanxi Weiyi grants even Yongjia's couplet already carries leaves and asks how one gets to the direct cut at all, closing that the heat forbids long standing, Tianru Weize sends the skilled listener to take it up at the direct-cut place and then, asked what that place is, holds the pause, shouts once, and descends, and Juelang Daosheng rules the old cases — the toppled pole, the Qingzhou shirt, the Luling rice price, the hemp three pounds — all of them the direct cut to the root, brooding barred, the grandfather seen whole in one roar. Wanru Tongwei's house prizes only the direct cut to the root and permits no leaf-seeking, so that blades stay calm and poison idle on the body that hangs no thread, Baichi Xingyuan makes the open-sun aim gather sage and commoner under the direct cut, every head revealing and every thing complete, Tian'an Sheng turns the enlightenment-day ask back on the asker — where did you get this news — and Yunwai Xingze rules that whoever wants the direct cut needs none of the din, the needle-hunters peering at the ground who today know Chan and tomorrow know Dao ending in the fox line.
